Careers

Careers

We're Hiring

RTC Vision develops a diverse range of computer vision technologies that include image enhancement, detection, tracking, 3D reconstruction, recognition, machine/deep learning, automation, and inspection solutions.

If you want to work in a challenging and diverse environment as part of a professional, cross-disciplinary team, join us at RTC-Vision.

We always seek high-caliber individuals with a passion for excellence, creativity, and quality performance in computer vision algorithms, machine/deep learning, and software engineering.

Forward resumes to: jobs@rtc-vision.com

Open Positions

Algorithms Engineer

We are looking for an algorithm engineer to join our team. As an algorithm engineer, you will be working on cutting-edge technologies, exciting and challenging projects, and will develop algorithms in Computer Vision and AI. In this role, you will collaborate with a diverse group of top talents in these fields.

The company is based in Rosh Haayin, Israel.

Work Experience Requirements:
  • M.Sc. in Computer Science / Mathematics / Electrical Engineering
  • Ph.D. - advantage
  • Hands-on experience in machine learning and deep learning
  • At least 5 years of experience in:
  • Algorithms development and implementation from design to the final product
  • Experience in C/C++/ .NET/Python/WINDOWS
  • Strong OOD/OOP skills coupled with experience with AI-assisted development tools and agentic development workflows
  • Good written and verbal English
  • Strong mathematical academic background
  • Advantage for background in Multi-view geometry/cameras/3D

RTC-Vision is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.
